source_commit_role: PR-008 hydration mount correction; contains the SSR wrapper, dashboard-root change, regression, and D12 update. STATUS and verification evidence are finalized in a follow-up documentation commit.
source_fingerprint_algorithm: SHA-256 of sorted `path SHA256\n` lines from source_sha256; generated dist, plan/STATUS.md, and evidence files excluded.

first_red.observation: The new route and hydration regression module did not compile before implementation: error[E0432], unresolved import `super::render_document`; no `render_document` in the root. The failure occurred before the route assertions ran.
first_red.red_output_capture: The compiler output was captured in the initial tool result and is transcribed exactly in execution.txt; no standalone red-run logfile was persisted.

resolved_browser_build_failure.diagnosis: The first browser wasm build called `dioxus_web::launch_cfg`, which is not exported at crate root; rustc suggested `dioxus_web::launch::launch_cfg`. It also reported an unused MemoryHistory import for wasm.
resolved_browser_build_failure.fix: Import launch_cfg through dioxus_web::launch and cfg-scope MemoryHistory to non-wasm targets.
resolved_browser_build_failure.verification: The final fresh-target CI built the browser wasm and assets successfully; see final_ci.

cargo_xtask_check.outcome: Formatting, Clippy with warnings denied, workspace tests, and layer validation passed.

final_ci.outcome: Workspace checks and tests, layer validation, API wasm build, dashboard browser wasm/wasm-bindgen asset bundle, and cargo audit all passed.

local_wrangler_smoke.hydration: Each SSR page includes the mount container and app root, JSON hydration script, bootstrap reference, and nonempty valid base64 payload. The regression test asserts the configured #main container is the parent of the .app-shell VDOM root.
local_wrangler_smoke.defunct_process_note: These two new workerd entries are adopted zombies because executor PID 1 does not reap children; no live Worker process remains.
local_wrangler_smoke.hydration_payload_check: The smoke parsed the SSR JSON script, required a nonempty valid base64 value, and verified the bootstrap reference. It did not execute browser JS or verify hydration completion; no headless browser was used.

no_comments_review.result: No source comments, TODO/FIXME markers, or lint-suppression attributes were added; no comments were deleted. The new expect calls are confined to cfg(test), and #![forbid(unsafe_code)] remains.

scope_notes: The shared Dioxus tree renders exactly `/`, `/funnels`, and `/funnels/:id`; route IDs are limited to 64 ASCII letters, digits, underscore, or hyphen.
The Worker keeps the host allowlist and existing API, health, probe, MCP, and fallback route ownership. ASSETS serves the generated bundle through Worker-first routing.

The SSR document now emits one outer #main mount container; the Dioxus .app-shell root is its direct child, matching dioxus-web Config.rootname("main"). The rendered page content still uses a semantic main landmark.
Dioxus escapes route content. The serialized hydration data is emitted in a JSON script with `<` escaped; browser bootstrap validates base64 before setting dioxus-web globals.
The root route uses an honest empty state; no funnel data CRUD, editor state, or fabricated metrics were added.
The hydration-root regression first failed before the correction and passes afterward. Six dashboard tests now pass.
The first fresh CI retry hit /tmp disk exhaustion. Only PR-008 temporary build targets were removed, with the prior final3 target/log preserved; a second empty target completed with CI_EXIT=0.
The final local smoke closed port 8787 and left no live Wrangler or Worker; executor PID 1 retains adopted defunct workerd entries as documented in D7.
Browser JS was not run in a headless browser. SSR structure, payload, and asset delivery were verified, but end-to-end browser hydration remains unverified.
Codex review on the earlier head c5d440c found P1 comment 4265712467. The finding is resolved in the local correction commit; hosted CI and a new Codex review on the correction head are pending push.
No remote binding or production deployment was run.

review_regression_red.observation: Before the fix, the new assertion failed because the SSR output began with the app root carrying id="main" rather than an outer mount container. The failure was observed before changing routes.rs/ssr.rs.
review_regression_red.regression: Assert the body has one id="main" element directly wrapping the Dioxus .app-shell root.

previous_fresh_ci_attempt.reason: The executor /tmp filesystem ran out of space during linker output; the shell could not write an exit marker for the same reason.
previous_fresh_ci_attempt.cleanup: Removed only the failed target and two older PR-008 temporary target directories; preserved existing PR-008 final2/final3 targets and their logs. The retry used a new empty target and passed.

codex_review_finding.finding: Dioxus rootname("main") selected an element also rendered as the application root, so hydration attempted to traverse a root VDOM under itself.
codex_review_finding.resolution: SSR now emits a separate outer #main mount container and the .app-shell VDOM root is its child; test hydration_mount_wraps_the_server_rendered_app_root covers this structure.
